meta.title: Notepad
meta.description: A per-workspace floating notepad in the session view. New segment cards lead the list; an empty title is just a blank click target until clicked. Click an index to select, drag to reorder, merge a selection, move between cards with the arrow keys, and improve only the selected cards with AI — the button turns into undo and identical content reuses the previous answer. Insert and send buttons expand on hover into current-session / new-session groups, while replace stays a single button. Image chips open an in-panel preview; active segments can be deleted directly after a confirmation that warns the action cannot be undone. The footer shows one shortcut tip at a time and rotates on click; copy-all skips archived segments; sending follows the General Settings busy-send policy. Pending counts appear on the hidden launcher and the sidebar workspace row, auto refresh keeps the list scroll position, Ctrl+Shift+0 (or the header reset button) resets the panel geometry, and the panel never covers the host title bar.
